scope: CAD-derived articulated topology and mass with explicit estimated finite joint dynamics; no hardware calibration. Saved CAD geometry and every physical occurrence retained.

suspension.provenance: Same estimated k/c/travel as native suspension topology probe, now with real aggregated CAD mass. Zero preload is an uncalibrated starting hypothesis, not equilibrium proof.
suspension.grouping: Main Body/Adjust Nut/coil on upper; Second Body/Bolt/Nut/Cap on lower, based on native coincident axes and axial reference placements. The source saved shock assembly is rigid and cannot itself prove dynamic travel.
suspension.coil_geometry: Unchanged rigid CAD reference on upper; spring force law belongs to prismatic joint. Mesh deformation is not represented.

gripper.provenance: Estimated finite-drive topology probe values, with real CAD leaf mass; holding/grasping force and range require subsequent native assessment.
